subject: general
question:
**Directions:** In the following question, two statements are given, followed by two conclusions (I and II). Assume the statements to be true even if they appear to contradict general facts. Determine which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:****
All televisions are radios.

Some radios are transistors.

Conclusions:**

I. All radios are televisions.

II. Some televisions are transistors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusion I and II follows.

solution:
Statements:

All televisions are radios.

Some radios are transistors.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b72a6421b20a12044d6e10642ca03f41893c0f283b288e5213281ad093a9bda.png] 

Conclusions:
I. All radios are televisions. - False (Because All televisions are radios, which means some radios are televisions.)
II. Some televisions are transistors. - False (There is no definite relation between televisions and transistors, it can be possible but it is not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
